messages:
elaine_csm: Quick debrief from onboarding call with Velociti (trial account). Captured 5 concrete asks + 2 blockers. Renewal touchpoint scheduled in 21 days — customer flagged activation risk. Posting raw notes so product can triage.

- Ask A: per-route cost visibility (they want CSV export + per-route filter in console).
- Ask B: ability to pin a model variant to a route (they have strict latency/cost mix).
- Ask C: SDK sample for bulk-embed workflow (Python + retry guidance).
- Ask D: webhook for session-level events (start/end, error codes).
- Ask E: prebuilt prompt templates for invoices use-case.

Blockers:
1) During burst tests their dedupe layer fails when we return streaming chunks >512 tokens (time-series merging problem). They can workaround by using non-streaming, but that doubles perceived latency.
2) Internal security team requires explicit KMS key mapping per environment; our private deploy option docs are unclear — they requested example config.

elaine_csm: Renewal risk note: CSM flagged as "yellow" — they said if we can't show a path for reducing initial latency and a KMS example by the pilot review (in 2 weeks) they'll push to another vendor. :warning:

elaine_csm: Raw excerpt: "If we can't get per-route logs and a simple KMS mapping example, legal won't sign off"

tom_pm: Thanks Elaine — can we get a quick prioritization? Which of these are blockers vs nice-to-have? I can slot a small spike for Ask A and blocker #1 this week. cc @ashwin_se

ashwin_se: Re: blocker #1 — I can reproduce the streaming chunk merge on my dev env. Need the exact payload they used; can you paste the recording or sample request? also curious which runtime (hosted vs dedicated) they tested against.

elaine_csm: Pasted sample (redacted) below from the call recording: 
```
POST /v1/generate
{"model":"rw-large","stream":true,"input":"<invoice_batch>...","max_tokens":1024}
```
They tested Hosted in us-west-2.

ashwin_se: Got it. Quick note: workaround is to set `stream_chunk_size=256` client-side, but that is not ideal. I'll try a kernel-side patch and report back.

tom_pm: For Ask A (CSV export) — is there an existing export endpoint we can reuse? If not, we should decide: quick export job vs UI filter change. Quick export is lower risk. :thumbsup:

maria_cs_director: Agree with prioritizing Ask A + blocker #1 + KMS example. Those directly affect procurement. If product needs endorsement to expedite, we should escalate — customer is a mid-ACV opportunity.

elaine_csm: Also the customer asked for an SDK snippet for bulk embeddings with exponential backoff. They said a one-page code sample would unblock their engs.

tom_pm: Action items I hear: 1) Engineering: reproduce + temp fix for streaming merge (ashwin), 2) Docs/Platform: KMS mapping example + snippet (I'll own), 3) Product: quick CSV export endpoint assessment (me), 4) CSM: send pilot review agenda and follow-up ask list (elaine).

feedback-bot: Feedback ticket created: FB-2026-1137 — linked to Velociti (trial). Queue: customer-success -> product-prioritization.

elaine_csm: Thanks team — I'll schedule a 30m sync with product/eng tomorrow 10:30 PT and invite Velociti if needed. If we can close the CSV export + KMS example in the next 7 business days we should be in a much better position for the pilot review. :eyes:
